name: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms
description:
About This Game

The Eastern Han Dynasty is crumbling, and the majestic capital of Luoyang has been ruthlessly engulfed in flames.

In this era of rising heroes, you shape your own destiny. Choose to pledge your loyalty to historic warlord factions, or stand together with other players to build your own forces and carve out your legacy in a chaotic world.

The game features dozens of historical units from the Three Kingdoms era. You can recruit elite troops once led by iconic figures like Lu Bu, Cao Cao, and Guan Yu, including renowned forces such as the Tiger and Leopard Cavalry.

From cavalry and archers to infantry and shieldbearers, diverse combinations of unit types and formations offer infinite tactical possibilities for strategic combat.

Victory on the battlefield relies on mastering unit counters and flawless teamwork with your allies. Exploit these tactical counters, coordinate offenses and defenses with your comrades, and pinpoint the enemy's weaknesses in an ever-changing battlefield to secure a decisive triumph.

You will face a spectacularly expansive and vibrant open world of the Three Kingdoms.

From historic cities and unyielding mountain passes to desolate frontiers and the heart of the Central Plains, every location is a strategic prize fiercely contested by you and rival players.

Beyond the endless warfare, this land breathes with the rhythm of daily life. Watch peasants tend to crops outside the walls, while merchants and caravans bustle within the cities.

Travel across diverse regions and experience the distinct cultures and customs of each territory.

Across this expansive open world, classic moments—such as the famous Oath of the Peach Garden—and fascinating hidden anecdotes take place, waiting for you to personally explore and witness.

Every discovery can bring unexpected rewards and achievements, leaving an unforgettable mark on your glorious journey.

Dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and shifting seasons will dictate your army's marching pace and the flow of combat.

Dense forests and tall grass conceal your movements, treacherous muddy swamps slow advancements, and blinding sandstorms or toxic miasma introduce unpredictable variables.

Master your surroundings and turn these natural conditions into the ultimate tactical advantage to crush your enemies.

Every great military campaign relies on a solid foundation of fortifications.

Construct defensive towers to halt enemy charges, establish medical camps to support your frontline, and build production sites to forge siege engines and amplify your firepower.

Read the battlefield and adjust your deployments in real-time to maintain absolute supremacy over your opponents.

An army marches on its stomach. Every supply route is a vital lifeline that decides victory or defeat.

You and your allies must personally escort grain and ration convoys, constantly fending off enemy raids and deadly interceptions along the way. Once a supply line is severed, even the most overwhelming advantage can instantly collapse. Protect your logistics, and you secure the key to victory.

Inherit the peerless martial prowess of epoch-defining generals like Guan Yu and Lu Bu to dominate the battlefield.

An all-new mechanic allows you to learn and execute the exclusive signature techniques of these historical legends. Experience uniquely stylized skill animations and devastating power.

Channel the exclusive abilities of different Three Kingdoms heroes to plunge into enemy formations and execute your rivals.

A brand-new combat mode introduces a thrilling, high-stakes 5v5vE experience.

Players will dive into dangerous, heavily guarded zones to fight over top-tier loot against rival squads.

It is a ruthless game of survival—if your character dies, all your carried items will be dropped.

Only the team that slays the final boss can claim victory and leave the battlefield fully loaded.

When the global war reaches its boiling point, all top-tier factions will march on the ultimate battleground: Luoyang.

The final showdown unfolds in a massive new warzone, where nearly a hundred players fight simultaneously, fiercely contesting key strongholds, camps, and strategic chokepoints.

Building fortifications, deploying siege weapons, and reinforcing the frontline—every single tactical command can turn the tide and become the key to victory.

In this absolute climax, overpowering your enemies requires more than just brute strength, courage, and cunning.

It ultimately depends on the unspoken trust between you and your allies, as well as the battle-forged instincts you've honed throughout your relentless campaign.
short_desc: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms is an open-world action war game blending hero combat and troop command. Lead legendary armies alongside allies to siege cities and claim vital resources. Forge alliances, crush rival factions, and seize the realm with steel and strategy!
